messages:
jen: seeing a black frame on the main live feed and a few audio dropouts. recorder still shows "recording" green but the stream is 0kbps. @ops @video-team can someone confirm? :rotating_light:
mark: on it. I can see the stream encoder spiking errors in the dashboard. sending logs now.
mark: ```enc-12: WARN: frame_encode_failed at pts=24342
enc-12: ERROR: dropped 3 frames in last 10s
```
priya: can we fail over to the backup ingest? that should be hot. @gabe can you flip the dns route?
gabe: prepping the backup. giving a 30s heads-up before switch. can someone start a local recorder just in case?
emma: I'm starting local OBS capture on my laptop -> disk. obs-profile: allhands_backup, saving to /tmp/allhands_local.mp4
emma: command I ran: `obs-cli --port 4455 service restart` and then `obs-cli --startrecording`
zach: checked NDI feed, the camera's sending keyframes but framerate is jittery. might be a network hiccup between stage switcher and encoder.
leo: quick ask: should we pause the Q&A or continue audio-only? leadership's mic is okay but video is flaky.
jen: let's continue audio-only for now and put a slide up saying "video issues, continuing audio Q&A". I'll post in participants.
ops-bot: Incident created - IN-2024-319: all-hands stream degraded -> video black frames. Pager sent to video-team.
mark: doing the DNS swap to backup ingest in 10...9...8...
mark: swapped. monitoring.
mark: encoder reports reconnected to backup, bitrate climbing.
mark: stream view shows picture back. please confirm on your end. :eyes:
emma: local recorder confirmed: 1h20m file being written, size increasing. checksum in progress.
priya: leadership footage still missing a few segments around 14:32; can we salvage from camera recorder? Gabe, can you pull cam1 SD card?
gabe: asked stage ops to hand over cam1 SD. ETA 6 minutes.
jen: thanks team. i'm posting a short apology slide now. can someone also clip the ~2m blackout to share with the product team?
leo: i'll take that. will stitch emma's local + cam1 once i get the SD. timeline ~15-20m.
mark: leaving encoder logs here: `s3://infra-logs/allhands/1748642090/encoder.log` (permission granted to video-team)
priya: can ops-bot add a follow-up action: add automated local-capture to all future all-hands by default. this would've saved a LOT of stress.
ops-bot: Action logged: TICKET-ALLHANDS-47 "Enable automatic local-record fallback for all hands" assigned to ops.
zach: quick note for next time: add a small heartbeat overlay that shows "last keyframe: Xs ago" so we can triage faster in UI.
jen: agreed. postmortem agenda item. also, recording URL (temporary) will be shared when uploads finish. thanks everyone for quick swap. :thumbsup:
gabe: cam1 SD recieved, copying files now to `s3://allhands-raw/1748642090/cam1/`
leo: grabbed cam1 files, beginning stitch with emma's local file. will attach final clip in #all-hands after processing.
jen: good job. filing follow-ups: - ops to enable auto-local-record - video-team to add heartbeat overlay - document failover playbook - verify encoder caps for future.
mark: leaving a note: encoder firmware needs patching, will schedule maintenance windows.
jen: closing thread once final clip posted. thanks again.
emma: final note: if anyone needs my local raw, I can drop it in the shared bucket.
leo: final: uploaded stitched clip and short timestamped notes to #all-hands. link: https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1748642090/stitched-clip.mp4
jen: confirmed receipt. closing. :white_check_mark:
